<issue>
Hyperlink address property returns None when hyperlink is present

#### Description

When accessing the `address` property of a hyperlink that has been set, it returns `None` instead of the expected URL. This affects all hyperlink operations including getting, setting, and removing hyperlinks.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.text.text import _Hyperlink

# Create a presentation with a text box
prs = Presentation()
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
textbox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(100, 100, 200, 50)
paragraph = textbox.text_frame.paragraphs[0]
run = paragraph.runs.add_run()

# Access the hyperlink and set an address
hlink = run.hyperlink
hlink.address = "https://example.com"

# Try to get the address back
print(f"Expected: https://example.com")
print(f"Actual: {hlink.address}")
```

The hyperlink address should return the URL that was set, but instead returns `None`.
</issue>
